title: The range at a glance
lede: Eighteen structured-light 3D cameras in five series, with fields of view from 9.8 mm to 3.6 m. One software platform, TridiVision, across the range. Every figure is stated the same way: field of view at the near, optimum and far working distance, point spacing at the optimum, Z repeatability as the regional 2σ value (definitions and method, page 22).
toc2_desc: TRS · VRH9 · VR · VRD · PRS, two pages each
toc4_desc: All models · series tables · accessories · definitions
h2_scatter: Field of view against Z repeatability
caption_scatter: Width of the field of view at the optimum working distance against regional Z repeatability, 2σ, for all eighteen models. Adjacent series overlap: most parts have two candidate models.
